newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore HSFO seen $1-$2/T higher with swaps.
newsitem.headline: Singapore HSFO seen $1-$2/T higher with swaps.

text.p: High sulphur fuel oil market was assessed $1-$2 per tonne higher from Wednesday, tracking swaps and crude gains but the market remained lacklustre, traders said on Thursday.
High sulphur 180-cst grade fuel oil was quoted at $121-$123 per tonne on Wednesday.
"The market was quiet as most traders are staying away, awaiting clearer indications before putting in any numbers," a local trader said.
"Players are also nervous as swap levels kept on rising," the trader said.
Traders said the market remained supported by Chinese demand and supplies were adequate.
In the swaps market, December was up at $122/$123, $1.25 higher from Wednesday's quotes, driven by the current firm physical fundamentals.
